A family I worked with returned this week after living in Morocco for the last 2 years with extended family. I got to see them, and was instantly dog piled with hugs by both parents and 4 kiddos.😭 

It was 100° in Columbus today and apparently Rabat was never as unbearably hot as it has been here.…

Menara Hassan: A Reflection of the Grandeur of Islamic Maghrib Civilization

Menara Hassan in Rabat, Morocco, is the unfinished minaret of the Almohad mosque, designed as the world's tallest minaret. Built at the end of the 12th century by Caliph Abu Yusuf
